comments.author: KaiErikNiermann
comments.body:
> noticed it gave a 404 error because it still points to the master branch instead of main

but... it doesn't ? From what I can tell github added master -> main redirects back in 2021. I mean it's a valid nitpick sure, but did you just makeup the fact that it 404'd ? 

``` bash
$ curl -sI https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md | grep -iE '^(HTTP|location)'
HTTP/2 302
location: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/tree/AI_POLICY.md
```
